description:
The best all-in-one screen recorder and video editor. Record your screen, add video effects, transitions and more.

Camtasia is a video-based screen capture program that enables users to demonstrate and communicate ideas or share knowledge using video. From quick video demos to extensive video projects, Camtasia has a wide range of editing tools to create video content from a variety of sources. Users can record from webcam or screen, introduce a variety of effects, and easily share videos over multiple channels.
New Features
- Added a settings option to access Standard updates for faster access to new features, or Delayed updates which may be more stable.
Feature Updates
- Renamed TechSmith Agent service to Camtasia Connector.
- Apply Look settings when toggling Effects in Rev.
- Automatically provide a suggestion for a filename when exporting captions.
Performance Improvements
- Improved startup time.
Updates for IT Administrators
- Updated DLL versions: charset-1.dll 1.18.0 → 1.19.0; ffi-8.dll 3.5.2 → 3.7.1; gio-2.0-0.dll, glib-2.0-0.dll, gmodule-2.0-0.dll, gobject-2.0-0.dll, and gthread-2.0-0.dll 2.86.3 → 2.88.2; girepository-2.0-0.dll 2.88.0 → 2.88.2; harfbuzz-gpu.dll, harfbuzz-raster.dll, harfbuzz-subset.dll, harfbuzz-vector.dll, and harfbuzz.dll 14.2.0 → 14.2.1; iconv-2.dll 1.18.0 → 1.19.0; libexpat.dll 2.8.0 → 2.9.0; pango-1.0-0.dll, pangocairo-1.0-0.dll, pangoft2-1.0-0.dll, and pangowin32-1.0-0.dll 1.57.1 → 1.58.0.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where colors in exported MP4 files could be slightly off.
- Fixed a bug where some HDR HEVC video streams could fail to decode.
- Fixed a potential startup crash related to audio waveform analysis.
- Fixed an issue when trying to remove a cursor click keyframe from a Step Capture image.
- Fixed error dialog appearing during Edit in Camtasia Snagit workflow.
- Dynamic Captions are removed from the Favorites tool when Dynamic Captions are suppressed by deployment options.
